digest.component_or_area: LLM runtime provider abstraction and selection
propositions: Rebar's LLM runtime branches on provider name strings rather than using a provider-factory abstraction, preventing first-class support for Bedrock and flexible OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Documentation claims REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL and REBAR_LLM_API_KEY work, but _pai_check_config refuses them outright, creating a capability gap between documented and actual behavior
Bedrock-hosted Anthropic models lose prompt caching, retry transport, timeouts, and native structured output when fronted by OpenAI-compatible gateways, and no provider-native path exists
Output mode selection and prompt-cache gating are hardcoded against provider name strings rather than capability profiles, making them fragile and unmaintainable
Signed verdict sidecars record a model string that no longer names the actual provider endpoint when routed through gateways, losing provenance information for audit and debugging
Per-pass model configuration cannot be expressed in a single environment variable for the four-pass verify workflow, blocking unified Bedrock adoption across all review passes
